sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Aonbarr is an Irish mythological beast. He is the enchanted steed of the Irish sea god Manannan Mac Lir. His name means froth, and it suggests the seafoam.

okr.objective: Record Aonbarr, an Irish mythological beast.
